description: Parkeren in Groningen, een stadspanelonderzoek is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gemeente Groningen. In mei en juni 2017 is de ‘contourennota Parkeren in de levende stad’ met de gemeenteraad en de Stadjes besproken. In deze nota is te lezen wat de gemeente Groningen op hoofdlijnen wil op het gebied van parkeren. Coverage: Gemeente Groningen. The portal files it under the publisher Gemeente Groningen. Its tags are enquete, parkeren, stadspanel. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PDF. The portal shows 2025-06-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
